<description>
**Problem:** AssumeUTXO verifies imported UTXOs against a hash we bake into the binary.
Every node reconstructs the same UTXO set during ordinary IBD, but [does not check its hash against the existing AssumeUTXO commitment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/32377).

**Fix:** During ordinary block validation, verify the provided AssumeUTXO hash when block connection reaches the corresponding block, stopping the node on a mismatch.
Flush pending changes to disk before hashing the UTXO set and comparing the result with the commitment.

Keep only the latest AssumeUTXO commitment per network to limit the extra hashing work during IBD, and update the release process to replace it.
Users who need older snapshots for research or other purposes can use a compatible older release or restore the corresponding commitment as `m_assumeutxo_data` and recompile.
</description>

[2026-10-25] r:5643008477 review COMMENTED by fametrano (contributor):
Concept ACK

One issue should be fixed before merge: a node that fails the new check aborts on an assertion, and a plain restart then syncs past the commitment without checking it again. I built 97b2138e39 with one digit of the regtest commitment's hash at height 299 changed, and let it sync the `feature_assumeutxo.py` chain to 310 from an unmodified node. In nine runs out of nine it logged the mismatch and the fatal error, then died with SIGABRT on `Assertion failed: (hashPrevBlock == view.GetBestBlock())` in `ConnectBlock`. Restarted with no new option, it starts at 299, syncs to 310 and never hashes the UTXO set again. `-reindex-chainstate` stops it once more, and a plain restart then syncs past 299 again. The same change on cce32b1687 syncs to 310. I can share the harness.

In `ConnectTip`, block 299 reaches the coins cache and the disk before the check, and the failure returns before `m_chain.SetTip`. The coins are at 299 while the chain stays at 298. Connecting 299 again, when the next block arrives during shutdown, trips the assert. The next start takes its tip from the coins. Moving the check after `UpdateTip` is not enough: on regtest the node then aborts in `CheckBlockIndex` instead. The unit test processes no block after the mismatch, so it reaches neither assert.

On warning versus stopping (Sjors, ajtowns): as it stands, the stop lasts only until the next restart.
</new_statements>
